major_concerns: Deterministic verifier specification is underspecified (coverage of semantic/regression checks unclear).
Topology synthesis and heterogeneity generation lack formal definition (threat to construct validity).
Prompt/template sensitivity and LLM selection not enumerated (internal validity).
No sample-size/power calculation or explicit N per bin; risk of underpowered interaction tests.
Failure modes and false-negative verifier behavior not planned (could bias against useful fixes).
required_design_repairs: Provide a formal verifier spec (syntax + semantic + reachability + policy oracles) with test-suite and failure modes.
Define topology-generation procedure with parameters for size/vendor heterogeneity and release example seeds/topologies.
Specify exact hosted LLM model identifiers, temperatures, and prompt templates; freeze them in preregistration.
Add an explicit sample-size/power calculation for primary outcome and preregister per-bin Ns and random seeds.
Define conservative retry policy and logging schema; record raw outputs, verifier traces, and hashes for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Orchestration roles and message schemas are underspecified (hard to reproduce/compare).
High estimated model-call budget risks API rate/cost limits and unequal cost comparisons between styles.
Prompt-sensitivity and template tuning could drive results rather than orchestration design.
Multiple pairwise comparisons require a clear multiple-testing plan to avoid false positives.
required_design_repairs: Precisely define orchestration protocols: message schemas, role prompts, max-turn limits, and deterministic tie-breakers; freeze templates.
Predefine cost-normalization method and limit M (iterations) so comparisons are cost-aware.
Include a multiple-comparisons correction plan and pairwise test choice in preregistration.
Run a small pilot to calibrate per-task model-call budget and ensure feasibility under API limits; report fallback policy if limits hit.

major_concerns: Many hosted APIs do not expose logits/probabilities; plan assumes access to reliable confidence proxies.
Calibration procedures and the train/test split for calibration are not specified (risk of optimistic estimates).
Operational gating thresholds are not anchored to a verifier baseline or real-world cost metric.
Monte Carlo uncertainty estimation increases model-call cost and variance if not budgeted.
required_design_repairs: Enumerate supported LLM APIs and exact signals available (logits, token-probs) and include proxy procedures if unavailable (e.g., sampling/ensembles).
Specify calibration workflow: held-out calibration set, method(s) (temperature scaling, isotonic), cross-validation folds, and evaluation metrics (ECE/Brier).
Define operational gating criteria (target false-accept rates) and clearly compare to verifier-gated baseline with cost accounting.
Precompute Monte Carlo sampling budget per task and freeze random seeds to bound compute; include fallback if API rate-limited.

major_concerns: Simulated human-reviewer heuristics are central but may not reflect operator behavior (external validity).
Semantic-trace schema is vague; reproducibility depends on a precise format and generation rules.
Simulated review-time modeling may be arbitrary without empirical grounding or human-pilot data.
Risk of circularity if reviewer heuristics implicitly replicate verifier checks.
required_design_repairs: Define a concrete semantic-trace JSON schema (fields, types, confidence/tags) and include generation prompt templates.
Specify the simulated-reviewer heuristic in full (rules, thresholds, time-cost model) and justify parameters or run a small human-pilot to calibrate latencies/decisions.
Ensure reviewer heuristics are independent from verifier logic (avoid duplicate checks) and document differences.
Add sensitivity analyses varying reviewer strictness and time-cost assumptions; preregister simulation parameters and seeds.

major_concerns: Model selection is unspecified (needed to ensure diversity and avoid correlated errors).
Merging/majority-vote rules are underspecified (line-level vs semantic merge).
Cost and API-rate implications of calling multiple models may be prohibitive; cost-normalization is required.
Ensemble may fail on correlated failure modes—need subgroup analysis to surface when ensemble helps/hurts.
required_design_repairs: List exact LLM model identifiers (2–3) and justify diversity (architecture/provider) in preregistration.
Define deterministic merging rules (line-level diff rules, semantic merge fallback) and tie-breaking policies; include examples.
Predefine cost-normalized evaluation metrics and per-task model-call caps; include fallback if API limits reached.
Include subgroup analysis plan to detect correlated failures and quantify when ensemble improves vs when it degrades correctness.
